# Agent Adda Report Theme Standard Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Make all generic HTML/PDF reports generated by `nse_agent` use the sector-rotation-inspired Agent Adda standard theme.

**Architecture:** Keep report rendering centralized in `terminal/reports.py`. The Markdown conversion stays unchanged, while the HTML shell gains a stable theme marker, shared sector-rotation-style classes, and standard KPI cards. Tests assert the contract so future reports do not silently drift.

**Tech Stack:** Python, pytest, static HTML/CSS generated by `terminal/reports.py`.

---

### Task 1: Add Theme Contract Test

**Files:**
- Modify: `tests/test_terminal_reports.py`

- [ ] **Step 1: Add a failing test**

Add a test that generates a generic HTML report into a temporary reports directory and asserts the standardized shell exists:

```python
def test_generated_html_uses_agent_adda_standard_theme(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(reports, "REPORTS_DIR", tmp_path)

    html_path = reports.generate_report(
        "# Market Recommendation\n\n| Symbol | View |\n|---|---|\n| ABC | Watch |",
        report_type="research",
        symbol="MARKET",
        output_format="html",
        title="Theme Contract Report",
        filename="theme_contract",
    )

    html = html_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    assert 'data-agent-theme="sector-rotation-standard"' in html
    assert "site-hdr" in html
    assert "metrics-row" in html
    assert "metric-card" in html
    assert "summary-card" in html
    assert "tbl-wrap" in html
    assert "data-table" in html
    assert "Theme Contract Report" in html
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Run the focused test and verify RED**

Run:

```bash
python -m pytest tests/test_terminal_reports.py::TestTerminalReports::test_generated_html_uses_agent_adda_standard_theme -q
```

Expected: FAIL because the current generic HTML template has no `data-agent-theme="sector-rotation-standard"` and does not expose the sector-rotation component shell.

### Task 2: Implement Standard Report Shell

**Files:**
- Modify: `terminal/reports.py`

- [ ] **Step 1: Add stable theme constants**

Near the HTML template section, define:

```python
AGENT_ADDA_REPORT_THEME_ID = "sector-rotation-standard"
AGENT_ADDA_REPORT_ENGINE = "Agent Adda Report Shell"
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Update `REPORT_HTML_TEMPLATE`**

Modify the template so the `<body>` has:

```html
<body data-agent-theme="{theme_id}">
```

Add sector-rotation-standard component classes to the shell:

```html
<header class="site-hdr topbar">
...
</header>
<main class="content page-layout">
  <section class="metrics-row standard-report-kpis">...</section>
  <section class="summary-card section report-content">...</section>
</main>
```

Add CSS aliases/classes inspired by `reports/latest/sector_rotation.html`: `site-hdr`, `hdr-inner`, `hdr-brand`, `hdr-title`, `hdr-meta`, `mbadge`, `content`, `metrics-row`, `metric-card`, `metric-label`, `metric-value`, `metric-sub`, `summary-card`, and `tbl-wrap`.

- [ ] **Step 3: Make tables use the shared wrapper**

In `_md_to_html_basic`, when a Markdown table is flushed, wrap the table with:

```html
<div class="tbl-wrap"><table class="data-table">
```

and close with:

```html
</table></div>
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Pass new template values**

In `_generate_html_report`, compute and pass:

```python
theme_id=AGENT_ADDA_REPORT_THEME_ID,
engine=AGENT_ADDA_REPORT_ENGINE,
badge_label=cfg["badge_label"],
report_subject=symbol or "Market",
```
